_readme: S644, 2026-11-13. Read 3 (run 43342288026, 1 load): each award name on a www.dvc.edu program area page links the eLumen catalog with a comma, not a slash: dvc.elumenapp.com/catalog/DVC2026-2027Catalog/program,a-s-in-administration-of-justice-for-transfer-fall-2025 (EL_PROGRAM_PATH and el_program_slugs take only /program/<slug>, which is why every eLumen read of Diablo Valley found 0). This read asks eLumen's content call for three of those programs (catalog,program,<slug>, the same call the reader makes for /program/<slug>) to see whether each prints its required courses and units, and renders the dvc-certs-and-degrees hub with comma links shown, to see whether eLumen itself lists every program. No model call.

questions.content_call: Does the content call for catalog,program,<slug> answer, and does it print the award's required courses and units?
questions.hub_programs: Does the dvc-certs-and-degrees hub (or the departments it grids) link programs at program,<slug>?
